title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported a Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Since 1994, 126 verified Bigfoot sightings have occurred in New England, with numerous reports in Massachusetts.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett argues there is no scientific evidence supporting the existence of Bigfoot.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Meredith Goldstein reflects on advice columnist Margo Howard's impact on her life after Howard's recent death at age 86.
Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, wrote popular advice columns including 'Dear Prudence' for Slate and 'Dear Margo' for the Boston Globe.
Howard's advice emphasized finding joy after loss and not dwelling on grief, lessons Goldstein integrates into her own life and work.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters, allowing two hits and no walks in six innings against the Athletics.
The Boston Red Sox defeated the Oakland Athletics 13-1, extending their winning streak to nine games.
Boston Red Sox bats produced 15 hits, including Jarren Duran's two-run home run and multiple high-scoring innings.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in competitive matchups at Patriots training camp, exchanging trash talk to enhance their games.
Gonzalez uses extra trash talk intentionally to prepare Brown for the challenges of facing other top NFL cornerbacks.
The Patriots have reportedly offered Gonzalez a new contract amid his active participation in training camp activities.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired from the Orioles, will start a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester Red Sox on Saturday.
Rutschman was placed on the injured list by Baltimore on July 20 due to left wrist inflammation.
The 28-year-old catcher has a .764 OPS this season and was Baltimore's lone All-Star representative in 2026.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' streaming on Paramount+ after a series finale reprise of the Nickelodeon hit.
'The Ballad of Wallis Island' starring Tim Key streaming on Peacock as a comedy-drama about a lottery winner.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 featuring Jason Sudeikis returns to Apple TV with a focus on a women's football team.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet is unlikely to return to the Red Sox starting rotation in 2026 due to injury recovery.
Crochet's bullpen experience with the White Sox increases his potential role in the Red Sox bullpen this season.
Interim manager Chad Tracy said Crochet might contribute as a reliever if he's healthy and ready to pitch.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python, nicknamed 'Tippy', was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester on Wednesday.
Residents reported the snake after seeing it abandoned in a cage in a community garden.
Boston Animal Care and Control is housing the python at their Roslindale facility and seeks information from the public.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 victory over Team White in Patriots' training camp scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas excelled for Team Blue, with six receptions and two touchdowns, including a 50-yard play.
Coach Mike Vrabel updated injury status, noting absence of key players like left tackle Will Campbell and cornerback Carlton Davis.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
The Lower Cape town features nearly 11 miles of shoreline, seven villages, and more than 20 beaches.
Local highlights include Saquatucket Marina, The Port Restaurant & Bar, and the Cape Cod Lavender Farm.
